hook_text: 4 000 seats, 2 637 sold. Three zeros on top and nothing to borrow from. Here is the one-second fix.
clip_script: Concert hall in Gqeberha, 4 000 seats, 2 637 sold. How many empty? 4 000 minus 2 637. Units: 0 minus 7. Cannot. Look left: 0. Look left: 0. Nothing to exchange until the thousands. The slow way: break a thousand into hundreds, a hundred into tens, a ten into units, and 4 000 becomes 3, 9, 9, 10. The fast way: take 1 off. 3 999 minus 2 637. Nines everywhere, no exchanging. 9 minus 7 is 2, 9 minus 3 is 6, 9 minus 6 is 3, 3 minus 2 is 1. 1 362. Add the 1 back: 1 363 empty seats. Check by adding back: 1 363 plus 2 637 is 4 000. True. Columns by place, units first, and when zeros block you, step down one and climb back.
visual_style: Whiteboard column subtraction with the 4 000 melting into 3 999 plus 1; seats in a hall grid turning grey as they are counted.
pacing: The blocked subtraction, the slow fix shown briefly, the fast fix, then the check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and subtract your age from 2 000 both ways.
